fact_text: If a refinery's ex-refinery price is pinned to an earlier, lower reference while it must buy crude at current import costs, the gap falls on the refinery and can push its gross margin negative.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'New Currency Notes, Petrol Prices Fall, 2 IPOs | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Petrol import cost can be set by the premium PSO pays on each cargo, while the refinery's ex-refinery price is fixed at an earlier level, so the difference is absorbed by refiners.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'New Currency Notes, Petrol Prices Fall, 2 IPOs | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Cutting the petroleum development levy lowers pump prices, but when the government does it the cost can be shifted onto refiners, who then face a smaller margin on each litre.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'New Currency Notes, Petrol Prices Fall, 2 IPOs | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Refiners argue their margins fund upgrade programmes, so a margin cut limits the capital they can put into refinery upgrades that the government has also agreed to.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'New Currency Notes, Petrol Prices Fall, 2 IPOs | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: New banknote designs in Pakistan are approved by the federal cabinet, while the State Bank announces the issue dates; older notes remain valid until then.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'New Currency Notes, Petrol Prices Fall, 2 IPOs | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The State Bank of Pakistan's inflation target is described as a band of 5 to 7 percent, and inflation running far above it is what prompts policy rate increases.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'New Currency Notes, Petrol Prices Fall, 2 IPOs | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The State Bank raises its policy rate when inflation runs well above its target band, to cool demand and bring inflation back toward the target.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'New Currency Notes, Petrol Prices Fall, 2 IPOs | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistan reports year-on-year CPI inflation separately for urban and rural areas, and the two series can move differently.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'New Currency Notes, Petrol Prices Fall, 2 IPOs | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Hopes of de-escalation in a regional war push global oil prices down and lift equities, while renewed escalation does the reverse; the analyst expects these swings to be temporary.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'New Currency Notes, Petrol Prices Fall, 2 IPOs | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)
